block.worldradio.speaker: Speaker
worldradio.range.hint: Stack end rods, bars, chains or lightning rods on top to extend the range (+%s blocks each).
worldradio.search.hint.empty: Type a station name or a genre, e.g. jazz
worldradio.station.clear.tooltip: Clear the station: nothing is sent from here until you tune it again
worldradio.status.disabled: Off – press Turn on or sneak + right-click
worldradio.status.nosignal: No signal for this station here
worldradio.transmitter.hint: Sends a signal only. Listen with a Radio or a Portable Radio in range.
worldradio.favorite.rename: Rename (Enter keeps the new name, Esc drops it)
worldradio.favorites.empty: No favorites yet. Tune a station and press the star to keep it here; your list is the same in every world.
worldradio.url.label: Stream address (MP3, .m3u or .pls)
worldradio.url.invalid: That is not an http(s) address.
worldradio.url.hint: Any internet radio that streams MP3 works, e.g. http://stream.kissfm.de/kissfm/mp3-128/internetradio/. AAC, Ogg and HLS streams are not supported.
worldradio.volume.tooltip: Volume of this radio for everyone who hears it. Your own radio volume: Options → Music & Sounds → Radio
worldradio.volume.tooltip.portable: Volume of this portable radio; only you hear it. Your overall radio volume: Options → Music & Sounds → Radio
worldradio.hearing.hint: Put Speakers against the radio, or against a speaker that is already connected, to be heard further (+%s blocks each). The sound gets quieter with distance and fades out just past this range.
worldradio.hearing.hint.portable: Stand the portable radio on top of a Speaker to be heard further (+%s blocks); more speakers can be chained to that one. The sound gets quieter with distance and fades out just past this range.
worldradio.channel.nohost: Not connected to a Radio Transmitter
worldradio.channel.hint: One more station for a Radio Transmitter. Put it against one, or against a channel of one.
worldradio.tuner.none: No station reaches this place. Go closer to a Radio Transmitter or an amplifier, or build one and tune it to a station.
worldradio.amplifier.none: No radio signal reaches this amplifier.
worldradio.book.start.text: World Radio brings internet radio into your world. A Radio Transmitter sends a station as a signal, and a Radio or a Portable Radio inside its range plays it.
worldradio.book.start.step1: Place a Radio Transmitter, right-click it and pick a station.
worldradio.book.start.step2: Stack antenna blocks on top of it for more range.
worldradio.book.start.step3: Place a Radio inside the range, right-click it and choose the station.
worldradio.book.transmitter.text: Sends its station as a signal to every radio in range. It makes no sound itself.
worldradio.book.transmitter.use: Right-click: pick a station. Sneak + right-click with an empty hand: on or off. A transmitter that is switched off sends nothing, its channels included.
worldradio.book.transmitter.more: It keeps sending while nobody is near. A signal stays in its dimension.
worldradio.book.channel.text: One more station for a transmitter. Tune it like a transmitter and put it against one, or against a channel that is already connected: beside it, below it or stacked, in any shape. Only the top of the transmitter stays free for the mast.
worldradio.book.channel.motto: "And now over to our second programme."
worldradio.book.channel.use: A channel never sends alone and takes no antenna: its station goes out over the transmitter's mast, with the transmitter's range. One transmitter sends up to %s stations.
worldradio.book.amplifier.text: Sends every signal that reaches it on again, at full strength and with its own range. Any number of amplifiers can follow one another.
worldradio.book.amplifier.use: It takes antenna blocks like a transmitter. Right-click lists the signals it receives, with the transmitter's position, the distance and the hops. It has no switch.
worldradio.book.receiver.text: Plays a station to everyone nearby. Its tuner lists the stations whose signal reaches this place.
worldradio.book.receiver.use: Right-click: choose a station and set the volume. Sneak + right-click with an empty hand: on or off. It is heard for %s blocks, and Speakers carry it further.
worldradio.book.receiver.direction: The sound comes from the block: turn around and it stays where the radio is. A Portable Radio you carry plays in both ears alike.
worldradio.book.receiver.silent: Silent? It plays only while it is switched on, tuned, and the signal of its station reaches it.
worldradio.book.speaker.text: Makes a radio heard further: every speaker adds %1$s blocks, up to %2$s.
worldradio.book.speaker.any: Any planks and any wool will do.
worldradio.book.speaker.use: Put it against a radio, or against a speaker that is already connected. The sound still comes from the radio. A connected speaker lights up while its radio plays.
worldradio.book.portable.text: A radio to carry. It plays to you alone while it is anywhere in your inventory, as long as the signal of its station reaches you.
worldradio.book.portable.item: Switched on and tuned, the item shows green lights and its antenna.
worldradio.book.portable.use: Right-click: the tuner, with stations and volume. Sneak + right-click into the air: on or off. Of several in the inventory, the first one that is switched on plays.
worldradio.book.portable.place: Sneak + right-click on a block puts it down. There it plays to everyone within %s blocks like a Radio. Standing on top of a Speaker it is heard further, and more speakers can be chained to that one. A bare hand breaks it at once to take it along again: it keeps its station.
worldradio.book.range.text: A transmitter reaches %1$s blocks. Every antenna block stacked straight on top of it adds %2$s more, up to %3$s antenna blocks (%4$s blocks).
worldradio.book.range.motto: "The higher the mast, the further the music."
worldradio.book.range.blocks: Lightning rods, end rods, and bars and chains of iron or copper. They can be mixed.
worldradio.book.range.place: Click an antenna block onto the top of a transmitter or an amplifier to place it. The mast ends at the first other block.
worldradio.book.range.display: The front lights up with the mast: dark while there is nothing to send, then one step each without antenna, with 1 to 3 antenna blocks, and with 4 or more.
worldradio.book.stations.text: The screen of a transmitter or a channel finds stations in four tabs.
worldradio.book.stations.favorites: Your own list, which comes with you into every world. The star adds or removes the station that is tuned in, the pencil renames one.
worldradio.book.stations.browse: Browse lists the stations of radio-browser.info by country and region. Search finds them by name or genre.
worldradio.book.stations.url: Paste any stream address. Playlists (.m3u, .pls) work too.
worldradio.book.stations.streams: Only MP3 streams play. While the screen is open it checks the station and shows the song title, or why the stream cannot be played. Clear removes the station.
worldradio.book.listening.text: Your own game streams the music, so it needs an internet connection. The server only passes the signal on.
worldradio.book.listening.volume: Every radio has its own volume slider, the same for everyone who hears it. Your own control is Options → Music & Sounds → Radio.
worldradio.book.listening.overlap: Where one station is heard from several radios, only the loudest one plays, so nothing echoes. Up to %s different stations play at once.
